title: Make the Discovery flow whole: guarded claims, spike recipe, primary-source rule
action: Implement CONTEXT.md D5-D8 (docs/history/two-flows/CONTEXT.md) exactly; match each file's voice. (1) PROVE D5 FIRST, per D6: pick a real ticket path under docs/discovery/ (for example docs/discovery/test-doctrine/tickets/001-enforcement-lines.md), run .bee/bin/bee reservations reserve --agent probe-tf2 --cell two-flows-probe --path <that path>, then .bee/bin/bee reservations list to observe it, then .bee/bin/bee reservations release for the same agent+path. Record the observed output in the finish report's deviations or outcome. If the reserve is refused for a docs path, DO NOT write the guard rule as law — instead write the fallback: the claimed-by line stays convention-only, plus an explicit stale-claim sweep rule, and report the refusal. (2) On a successful probe, write D5: in skills/bee-wayfinding/SKILL.md's 'Later sessions' claim step and in references/wayfinding-reference.md's resolution protocol, state that claiming a ticket reserves its file (bee reservations reserve --agent <name> --cell <effort>-wayfinding --path docs/discovery/<effort>/tickets/NNN-<slug>.md) alongside the display-only claimed-by line, that the frontier is open, unblocked, and UNRESERVED tickets, that a reservation deny means take another ticket and report the conflict rather than writing through it, and that a dead session's claim expires with its heartbeat instead of lying forever. Replace the current convention-only wording (the 'convention-only in v1 — no CLI guard' line in the reference and the matching SKILL.md line) so the two files agree; keep blocked-by convention-only and say so. (3) Add a one-line flow-position note near the top of skills/bee-wayfinding/SKILL.md: it is the spine of the Discovery flow, and the flow exits into bee-shaping's Lock. (4) D7: in references/wayfinding-reference.md 'Spike rules', add the LOGIC-page recipe — the page reads top to bottom as title plus the question, a labelled state panel re-rendered after every action (labelled fields, never raw JSON), one free-play button per action, and guided-walkthrough steps that each reset to a known initial state — and the cap that more than five variants stops being different and starts being noise. Keep it to a few lines in the existing voice. (5) D8: in skills/bee-researching/references/research-protocol.md step 4, state the primary-source rule — a secondary write-up is not evidence; follow every claim back to the source that owns it (official docs, the source code, the spec, the first-party API). (6) expertise/planning.md 'Spike craft': add the same five-variant cap in one clause, consistent with the wayfinding wording. (7) Run the regen chain in this cell: bee dev regen, then bee dev release-manifest --write; the .bee/expertise tree is the vendored copy of expertise/ and must end identical. One commit, imperative subject, cell id trailer.

The LOGIC-page recipe, the five-variant cap, and the primary-source rule all landed
